name: Codeword Agent #4: Meeting Notes to Action Items

parameters.content:
## Agent #4: Meeting Notes to Action Items

**Setup (5 minutes)**
1. Open **Config: Your Business** and replace every "FILL IN" value.
2. Optional: adjust **Config: Agent Settings**.
3. Open **Claude** and pick your Anthropic credential.
4. Open both Gmail nodes and pick your Gmail credential.
5. Click **Publish** (**Activate** in older n8n versions), then open the production URL from **Paste a Meeting Transcript**.

Nothing is sent to attendees. The follow-up is saved as a Gmail draft for you to review.

parameters.formDescription: Paste a call transcript. You get the summary and action items by email, plus a follow-up email saved as a Gmail draft.

values.placeholder: Comma separated. Leave blank to draft the follow-up to yourself.
Paste the full transcript (Zoom, Meet, Fathom, Otter, etc.)

values.formSubmittedText: Got it. Check your inbox for the notes and your Gmail drafts for the follow-up.

assignments.name: what_you_do
assignments.value: FILL IN: One or two sentences on what you sell and who it helps

assignments.name: ideal_customer
assignments.value: FILL IN: Who you want to work with (industry, size, role)

assignments.name: tone_of_voice
assignments.value: Friendly, direct, plain English. No hype, no buzzwords.

assignments.name: email_signature
assignments.value: FILL IN: Your sign-off, e.g. Talk soon, Sam

assignments.name: follow_up_goal
assignments.value: Recap what was agreed, list next steps with owners, and confirm the next meeting if one was mentioned.

messageValues.message:
=You turn meeting transcripts into clear notes and a follow-up email.
You work for {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.your_name }} at {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.business_name }}.
What they do: {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.what_you_do }}
Their ideal customer: {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.ideal_customer }}

Rules you always follow:
- Only use facts that appear in the input. If something is missing, say "Not found" or leave it out. Never invent names, numbers, dates, news, or quotes.
- Never promise results, revenue, savings, or timelines, and never make income claims.
- Write in this tone: {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.tone_of_voice }}
- Reply with JSON only, no extra text.
- An action item owner must be a person named in the transcript. If it is unclear, use "Unassigned".
- A due date must be stated in the transcript. Otherwise use "Not set".
